inputs.text: These anti-Trump radicals launched their so-called "No Kings" rally with crowds packing the streets in open defiance of established leadership, but federal officers had no choice but to respond with tear gas and arrests to restore control. The situation descended into chaos because of the volatile crowd, prompting authorities to order everyone to disperse, and at least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland and Denver. This is the predictable result when left-wing agitators reject traditional authority, national institutions, and the rule of law in favor of disruption and demands that threaten social order.
